reason: I won't spend $360 on a light from a store I've never heard of that has barely any reviews. The UL listing numbers and the free returns are nice, but I'd still be the guinea pig, and I have 40 pendants on my Pinterest board to pick from elsewhere.
objection: Almost no reviews and no track record. I'd google 'is Nora Furnish legit' and find nothing, and I also suspect I can find this same paper cloud light for much less on Amazon or AliExpress.
would_change_my_mind: A solid pile of independent reviews (Trustpilot, Google, photos from real buyers in real rooms) or seeing the store mentioned by a design blog or renovation forum I trust.
